services.name: Whale Watching
services.desc: From December to May the Maui coast becomes the “cradle of the humpback”. With the prime times being from the end of February and through April, it is during these four months that Seafire Charters often gets to see the beauty of these majestic creatures first hand. Your two-hour adventure begins at 10:45 AM, at our meeting location, the Kihei Boat Ramp, only 5 minutes away from most Wailea Resorts and within walking distance to the South Kihei Resorts; this is a prime location to launch into the “cradle of the humpback”. Hawaiian waters are special, they provide the perfect conditions for migrating humpback whales from Alaska looking for a warm place to calve, mate and rear their young.

services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Fresh Maui Pineapple, muffins and cold drinks (you may also B.Y.O.B. - no glass please) Seafire Charters offers you the ability to customize your own adventure for the perfect way to experience the waters of Maui! Whether it’s a sunset cruise, a trip to the coral gardens, whale watching, a birthday party, anniversary gift or a special vacation memory, there’s no better way to experience the islands than from the beautiful waters of Hawaii. At Seafire Charters, your safety comes first. Due to the nature of the ride, pregnant women, children under 4 years old, those with back or neck injuries, or those who had a recent surgery should use discretion.
